children: Paxos has deployed its regulated financial infrastructure on Avalanche, expanding institutional access to AVAX and Avalanche-native USDC for institutions and payment providers. The integration brings Paxos' compliance and settlement tooling to the network as a live deployment rather than an announcement of future work.

For investors, the deployment opens a regulated channel for institutional AVAX exposure and payment flows built on Avalanche-native USDC. Paxos' platform, as described by the source, serves more than 650 institutions and over 470 million users, so the integration connects Avalanche to an existing compliance framework rather than requiring institutions to build their own. The practical effect depends on adoption: the infrastructure is live, but actual institutional flows and usage levels remain to be seen.
